note: Triennial election of Londonderry County Council. Nominations were received at the Courthouse, Londonderry, on 2 May 1939 by T. B. Adams, secretary and returning officer. At the close of nominations there was no opposition in any electoral division; every candidate nominated was declared elected, and in Portstewart and Dungiven, where no nominations were received, the retiring members were deemed re-elected (Belfast News-Letter, 3 May 1939, p. 6, 'No Contests'). No county council poll was therefore held. The paper prints no party labels. Co. Londonderry polled Friday 2 June 1939: 'Polling in the Enagh Lough Division ... took place yesterday' (Londonderry Sentinel, 3 June 1939, p. 8).
